method.run_pf: team-season (home RS+RA per game) / (road RS+RA per game) from StatsAPI schedule final scores, regular season only; centered on the unweighted LEAGUE-season mean ratio (registered centering; sport-season pooled fallback when a league is unlabeled or has under 4 rated teams); EB-shrunk toward 1.0 with K_G=70 home games; venue = modal home venue; venue-season = home-game-weighted mean; 3-season venue window uses only seasons <= t (vintage-safe)
method.hr_pf: team home/away HR per game from the league-wide team statSplits fetch (hitting HR + pitching HR allowed = all HR at the venue), same centering/shrink/window. hr_pf feeds NO frozen eFV formula (iso/slg neutralize via run_pf); it is carried for display/audit and clamped [0.80, 1.25] on read
method.note_2026: 2026 is in season; its factors use partial schedules plus the 2024-2025 window legs
